quarterly_data.quarter: BillionToOne press release: BillionToOne's Tissue-Free Northstar Response Demonstrates (10-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: BillionToOne announced publication in The Journal of Liquid Biopsy of what it calls the first peer-reviewed head-to-head study (company claim) comparing Northstar Response, its tissue-free, methylation-based liquid biopsy assay using single-molecule counting of circulating tumor DNA, with a commercially available tumor-informed ctDNA assay in advanced cancer patients undergoing treatment. The retrospective real-world study evaluated 169 paired samples from 61 patients, with 71 samples from 36 patients having sequential concurrent draws within seven days of each other. Quantitative results after patient-specific baseline normalization were closely aligned (conditional R² = 0.97), and the two assays reached the same conclusion on the direction of change in tumor burden in 94% of evaluable sequential pairs (67 of 71); in all divergent cases Northstar Response matched the ground truth from imaging and/or biopsy, including detecting progression where the tumor had evolved since the original biopsy. The company says the study found Northstar Response tracked disease dynamics on par with or better than the tumor-informed comparator without requiring tissue sequencing, and that its workflow can accelerate the start of treatment monitoring, potentially by weeks. Allen Chen, VP of Oncology Clinical Development and Medical Affairs: 'These results show that clinicians do not need to compromise one for the other.'
